name: WaCRM - Notificar cliente por etapa del deal

parameters.query: SELECT d.phone, d.recibe, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contacts c JOIN conversations v ON v.contact_id = c.id JOIN messages m ON m.conversation_id = v.id WHERE c.phone = d.phone AND m.sender_type = 'customer' AND m.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS ventana_abierta FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN $2 = 'admin' THEN (SELECT c.phone FROM contacts c JOIN contact_tags ct ON ct.contact_id = c.id JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE lower(t.name) = 'admin' ORDER BY c.created_at LIMIT 1) ELSE (SELECT c.phone FROM conversations v JOIN contacts c ON c.id = v.contact_id WHERE v.id = $1::uuid) END AS phone, (SELECT CASE WHEN x.monto IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE rtrim(rtrim(to_char(x.monto, 'FM999,999,999,990.99'), '0'), '.') || ' ' || CASE WHEN x.moneda = 'CUP' THEN 'CUP' ELSE CASE (CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(o.delivery_method,'')) <> '' THEN lower(o.delivery_method) ELSE coalesce((SELECT b.beneficiary_type FROM remittance_beneficiaries b WHERE b.operation_id=o.id AND b.status='vigente' ORDER BY b.position LIMIT 1),'') END) WHEN 'zelle' THEN 'USD por Zelle' WHEN 'clasica' THEN 'USD de Clásica' WHEN 'tropical' THEN 'USD de Tropical' WHEN 'efectivo_usd' THEN 'USD en efectivo' WHEN 'cuban_card' THEN (CASE WHEN x.moneda = 'USD' THEN 'USD' ELSE 'CUP' END) ELSE coalesce(x.moneda, o.destination_currency, '') END END END FROM remittance_operations o CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN o.quoted_destination_amount IS NOT NULL THEN o.quoted_destination_amount WHEN c.n = 1 THEN c.total WHEN bf.n = 1 AND bf.sin_monto = 0 AND bf.moneda IN ('USD','CUP') THEN bf.total END AS monto, CASE WHEN o.quoted_destination_amount IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN c.n = 1 THEN c.moneda WHEN bf.n = 1 AND bf.sin_monto = 0 AND bf.moneda IN ('USD','CUP') THEN bf.moneda END AS moneda FROM (SELECT count(DISTINCT e.amount_currency) AS n, sum(e.amount) AS total, max(e.amount_currency) AS moneda FROM remittance_calculator_entries e WHERE e.operation_id = o.id AND e.voided_at IS NULL AND e.amount_currency IN ('USD','CUP')) c, (SELECT count(DISTINCT bb.currency) AS n, sum(bb.amount) AS total, max(bb.currency) AS moneda, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bb.amount IS NULL) AS sin_monto FROM remittance_beneficiaries bb WHERE bb.operation_id = o.id AND bb.status = 'vigente') bf) x WHERE o.id::text = $3 LIMIT 1) AS recibe) d;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const f = $('Filtrar cambio de etapa').first().json; const to = (($json.phone || '').startsWith('+') ? $json.phone : '+' + $json.phone); const ventana = $json.ventana_abierta === true; const NL = String.fromCharCode(10) + String.fromCharCode(10); if (f.destino === 'admin') { const a = f.alerta; if (ventana) { const text = (a && a.titular && a.cuerpo && a.detalle && a.accion) ? ['*Aviso de Remesas Ya*', '*' + a.titular + '*', a.cuerpo, '*Detalle:* ' + a.detalle, '*Que hacer:* ' + a.accion, 'Entre al panel del CRM para el resto.'].join(NL) : String(f.mensaje || ''); return JSON.stringify({ to, type: 'text', text }); } if (a && a.titular && a.cuerpo && a.detalle && a.accion) { return JSON.stringify({ to, type: 'template', template: { name: 'alerta_operativa_v2', language: 'es', params: [a.titular, a.cuerpo, a.detalle, a.accion] } }); } const resumen = String(f.mensaje || '').replace(/[\r\n\t*_]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,600); return JSON.stringify({ to, type: 'template', template: { name: 'alerta_operativa', language: 'es', params: [resumen] } }); } const recibe = String($json.recibe || '').trim(); if (f.plantilla && !ventana) { const params = (f.plantilla.params || []).map((p) => p === '{RECIBE}' ? (recibe ? '*' + recibe + '*' : 'hoy') : p); return JSON.stringify({ to, type: 'template', template: Object.assign({}, f.plantilla, { params }) }); } const text = String(f.mensaje || '').replace('{RECIBE}', recibe ? ' de *' + recibe + '*' : ''); return JSON.stringify({ to, type: 'text', text }); })() }}

parameters.query:
SELECT cerebro_config_get('notify_secret') AS secreto,
       cerebro_config_get('notify_secret_legacy') AS secreto_legacy,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remittance_admin_audit a
                WHERE a.table_name = 'remittance_operations'
                  AND a.row_id::text = $1
                  AND a.action IN ('human_deposit_verification','human_forced_verification','automation_late_deposit_verification')
                  AND a.created_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes') AS verificacion_manual,
       (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
                 'beneficiary_type', rb.beneficiary_type, 'name', rb.name,
                 'card_number', rb.card_number, 'phone', rb.phone,
                 'zelle_account', rb.zelle_account, 'address', rb.address, 'id_photo_wamid', rb.id_photo_wamid,
                 'reference', rb.reference, 'contact_phone', rb.contact_phone, 'amount', rb.amount) ORDER BY rb.position, rb.created_at), '[]'::json)
          FROM remittance_beneficiaries rb
         WHERE rb.operation_id::text = $1 AND rb.status = 'vigente') AS beneficiarios,
       (SELECT d.notes FROM remittance_operations o JOIN deals d ON d.id = o.deal_id
         WHERE o.id::text = $1) AS notas_deal,
       cerebro_riel_op(NULLIF($1, '')::uuid) AS riel;
